peft.standalone: Nin LoRA / PEFT adapɛri in b’a ka basigi modɛli dafalen de wajibiya. Basi don a kɔnɔ ani ka adapɛri nɔrɔ Safetensors dilanbaga kɔnɔ; adaptateur hakɛ dɔrɔn tɛ hakilijagabɔ ye min ka kan ka kɛ walasa k’a baara.
peft.attach: LoRA / PEFT adapɛri dɔ nɔrɔ a la
peft.description: Basi modɛli dafalen sugandi sanfɛ, o kɔfɛ a ka adapɛri foli. Adaptɛri kelen tɛ modɛli dafalen ye. Base identité ka kan ka bɛn adaptateur configuration ma.
peft.estimate: Konsɛrɛvatif CPU jateminɛ kɛra 2,048 tokenw kan. Jatebɔ kɛra kokura minɛn sugandilen ni a kɔnɔkow kama doni waati. Laɲini moduluw ni tensor cogoyaw bɛ lajɛ doni tali waati.

noInstalledModels: Modeli si ma sɛbɛn nin kulu in kɔnɔ.
limitedSupport: Nin furakɛlikɛla in bɛ se ka dɛmɛ dafalen sɔrɔ. Seko ni dɔnko (baarakɛminɛnw, yeli, mankan) tɛ sɔrɔ u yɛrɛma - ka modɛliw fara a kan bolo la ani ka sekow labɛn modɛli kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
mlxExperimental: MLX dɛmɛ ye kɔrɔbɔli ye. Embeddings tɛ sɔrɔ, reasoning toggle ma wire fɔlɔ, wa model architecture kura dɔw bɛ se ka dɛsɛ ka doni. Kow fɔ GitHub kan walasa an ka se k’u bila jɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ la.
engineBundled: Inference engine bɛ don Novera kɔnɔ, o la foyi tɛ telesarse walima ka ladamu a danma. Aw bɛ nin version in fɔ ni aw bɛ modeli dɔ lakali min ma se ka doni ta.
engineOtherVersion: Aw mago bɛ llama.cpp bɔko wɛrɛ la wa? Aw ye aw yɛrɛ ka llama-server boli k'a fara a kan i n'a fɔ OpenAI-baarakɛla ladamulen.
refreshModelsError: Ladilikɛla ka kan ka basigi URL sɔrɔ ani API kilisi kelen a dɔgɔyalenba la min labɛnna walasa ka modɛliw ta.
refreshModelsSuccess: A ye {{count}} modɛli(w) kura fara a kan ka bɔ {{provider}} la.
noNewModels: Modeli kura si ma sɔrɔ. Modeli minnu bɛ sɔrɔ, olu bɛɛ farala ɲɔgɔn kan kaban.
refreshModelsFailed: A ma se ka modɛliw sɔrɔ {{provider}} fɛ. Aw ye aw ka API kilisi ni basigi URL lajɛ.
backendHistoryEmpty: Backend update si ma sɛbɛn fɔlɔ.
backendHistoryRolledBack: A bɛ wuli ka segin kɔ
embeddingModels: Modeli minnu bɛ don a kɔnɔ
embeddingModelsDesc: A bɛ kɛ RAG ani vektɔri ɲinini kama. Modeli sugandilen bɛ Kɛ default (dafalen) ye ni embeddings (daɲɛw) bɛ Bɔ.
embeddingModelSetDefault: A sigilen don i n’a fɔ embedding model default
importedTooltip: A bɛ don ka bɔ sigida dosiye dɔ la. A bɔli Novera kɔnɔ, o tɛna filen in bɔ disiki kan.
importModelSuccess: Modeli {{provider}} donna a kɔnɔ ka ɲɛ.
importModelError: A ma se ka don modeli la:
noModelFoundDesc: Modeli minnu bɛ sɔrɔ, olu bɛna sɛbɛn yan. Ni aw ma modeli si sɔrɔ fɔlɔ, aw bɛ taa Hub la walasa ka telesarse.
noModelFoundRemoteDesc: Modeli minnu bɛ sɔrɔ, olu bɛna sɛbɛn yan. Baara kɛ ni butɔni ye min bɛ sanfɛ walasa ka modɛliw ta ka bɔ furakɛlikɛla fɛ, walima ka dɔ fara a kan bolo la ni + butɔni ye.
